simple.prompt: Contrasting formal connector: 'The initial trial failed; ___, subsequent iterations achieved higher precision.'
simple.explanation: 'Nevertheless' / 'Nonetheless' adalah konjungtor transisi formal untuk menyatakan kontras konsesif ('meskipun demikian').
hints: Menyatakan 'meskipun demikian' secara formal.
Gunakan 'nevertheless'.

simple.prompt: Result connector: 'The corporation breached fiduciary duties; ___, it was fined ten million dollars.'
simple.explanation: 'Consequently' menandai akibat langsung atau konsekuensi hukum/logis dari kalimat sebelumnya.
hints: Menandai konsekuensi/akibat logis.
Gunakan 'consequently'.

simple.targetSentence: The software is efficient furthermore it provides comprehensive data encryption.
simple.explanation: The software is efficient + furthermore it provides comprehensive data encryption.
hints: Poin pertama: 'The software is efficient'.
Penambahan formal: 'furthermore it provides comprehensive data encryption'.

simple.prompt: Alternative contrast: 'Western economies slowed; ___, emerging Asian markets experienced robust growth.'
simple.explanation: 'Conversely' digunakan untuk menyajikan situasi sebaliknya (kebalikan langsung).
hints: Menyatakan situasi sebaliknya.
Gunakan 'conversely'.

simple.targetSentence: Costs increased sharply accordingly retail prices were adjusted upwards.
simple.explanation: Costs increased sharply + accordingly retail prices were adjusted upwards.
hints: Penyebab: 'Costs increased sharply'.
Penyesuaian akibat: 'accordingly retail prices were adjusted upwards'.

simple.prompt: Clarification connector: 'The treaty applies to all maritime vessels, ___ commercial freighters and passenger liners.'
simple.explanation: 'Namely' (yaitu/secara spesifik) digunakan untuk merinci atau menyebutkan contoh entitas secara definitif.
hints: Bermakna 'yaitu' atau 'secara spesifik'.
Gunakan 'namely'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kontras dengan 'On the contrary'.
simple.targetSentence: He is not indolent on the contrary he works tirelessly.
simple.explanation: He is not indolent + on the contrary he works tirelessly.
hints: Membantah klaim: 'He is not indolent'.
Klarifikasi kontras: 'on the contrary he works tirelessly'.

simple.prompt: The electric bus trial achieved high passenger ratings; ___, charging station installation lagged behind schedule.
simple.explanation: Dua klausa yang dipisah titik koma membawa kontras antara kepuasan tinggi dan keterlambatan instalasi pengisian daya: gunakan 'however' atau 'nonetheless'.
hints: Klausa kedua menyoroti kendala yang bertolak belakang dengan keberhasilan awal.
Pilih konektor kontras.

simple.prompt: Grid battery costs fell by thirty percent; ___, municipal utilities accelerated solar storage orders.
simple.explanation: Klausa kedua merupakan akibat langsung dari turunnya harga baterai; gunakan 'consequently' (setara 'therefore' / 'as a result').
hints: Hubungan antar-klausa adalah sebab → akibat.
Konektor hasil adalah 'consequently'.

simple.prompt: The mobile app offers instant voice transcription; ___, it exports clean summaries in three formats.
simple.explanation: Menambahkan keunggulan kedua yang searah memakai konektor aditif formal 'furthermore' atau 'moreover'.
hints: Kedua klausa sama-sama memuji fitur aplikasi.
Penambah poin searah memakai 'furthermore / moreover'.

simple.prompt: Export agriculture grew steadily in northern valleys; ___, timber shipments in southern ports declined slightly.
simple.explanation: 'Conversely' menyoroti perbandingan dua tren atau hasil yang bergerak ke arah berkebalikan (satu naik, satu turun).
hints: Tren utara dan selatan bergerak berlawanan arah.
Konektor kebalikan tren adalah 'conversely'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang memperjelas istilah dengan apposition connector.
dialogue: Student
Should I clarify which fiscal period my chart covers right inside the sentence?
Advisor
Yes — insert the appositive abbreviation ___, meaning 'that is to say', right before 'Q1 through Q3'.
simple.explanation: 'Namely' (atau singkatan Latin 'i.e.' / 'that is') berfungsi mempersempit atau menyebutkan secara spesifik hal yang dimaksud sebelumnya (berbeda dengan 'e.g.' yang hanya memberi sebagian contoh).
hints: Memperjelas identitas tepat satu periode ('yaitu Q1 sampai Q3').
Gunakan 'namely / i.e.'.

simple.prompt: The coastal rail upgrade will reduce freight travel times, ___ at a substantial upfront capital cost.
simple.explanation: 'Albeit' adalah konektor konsesi ringkas sebelum frasa preposisi atau kata sifat tanpa perlu klausa kerja penuh.
hints: Setelah rumpang hanya terdapat frasa preposisi 'at a substantial upfront capital cost'.
'Albeit' masuk langsung sebelum frasa tanpa verb.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan tanda baca koma (comma splice) saat memakai 'therefore' di tengah kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Water pressure dipped overnight, therefore, the automatic irrigation cycle paused until dawn.
options: Water pressure dipped overnight; therefore, the automatic irrigation cycle paused until dawn.
Water pressure dipped overnight, therefore the automatic irrigation cycle paused until dawn.
Water pressure dipped overnight; therefore the automatic irrigation cycle paused until dawn.
simple.explanation: Conjunctive adverb seperti 'therefore', 'hence', dan 'moreover' wajib didahului titik koma (;) atau titik (.) saat menyambung dua klausa independen, dan diikuti koma (,).
hints: Jangan gunakan koma sebelum 'therefore' di antara dua kalimat utuh.
Gunakan titik koma (;) sebelum 'therefore,' dan koma sesudahnya.

simple.prompt: ___ initial skepticism among rural shopkeepers, contactless QR adoption tripled within six months.
simple.explanation: 'Notwithstanding' adalah preposisi konsesif formal (setara 'Despite') yang langsung diikuti frasa benda ('initial skepticism...').
hints: Setelah rumpang hanya berupa frasa benda tanpa kata kerja.
Gunakan preposisi konsesif 'Notwithstanding'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai konektor sebab-akibat formal 'accordingly'.
simple.targetSentence: Seasonal rainfall fell below average; accordingly, reservoir managers tightened irrigation quotas.
simple.explanation: 'Accordingly' (= menindaklanjuti hal tersebut) menyambung sebab dan tindakan penyesuaian yang logis.
hints: Awali dengan 'Seasonal rainfall fell below average;'.
Sambungkan dengan 'accordingly, reservoir managers...'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai 'by the same token' untuk perbandingan sejajar.
simple.targetSentence: Consistent design aids reader comprehension; by the same token, erratic typography causes fatigue.
simple.explanation: 'By the same token' (= dengan alasan yang sama pula) menghubungkan dua analogi searah.
hints: Mulai dengan klausa pertama diikuti titik koma.
Lanjutkan dengan 'by the same token, erratic typography causes fatigue'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis kebijakan moneter dengan 'hitherto'.
dialogue: Journalist
Is this interest rate hike unprecedented?
Economist
Yes, it breaks with what had ___ been a decade of ultra-loose monetary stimulus.
intermediate.explanation: 'Hitherto' adalah adverbia formal tingkat tinggi yang berarti 'hingga saat itu' (until that time / previously).
hints: Bermakna 'sebelum saat itu / hingga titik itu'.
Gunakan 'hitherto'.

intermediate.prompt: Forward-looking temporal connector: 'The new compliance regulations will take effect tomorrow; ___, all cross-border transfers require prior authorization.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Henceforth' bermakna 'mulai saat ini dan seterusnya' (from this time onward).
hints: Bermakna 'mulai saat ini seterusnya'.
Gunakan 'henceforth'.

intermediate.prompt: Concession with 'Be that as it may': 'The cost of modernizing the rail network is astronomical. ___, modern infrastructure is indispensable for long-term growth.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Be that as it may' (meskipun demikian halnya) adalah formula konsesi retoris elegan dalam debat dan esai formal.
hints: Formula konsesi retoris formal.
Gunakan 'Be that as it may'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat transisi dengan 'In like manner'.
intermediate.targetSentence: In like manner the secondary hypothesis received empirical confirmation.
intermediate.explanation: In like manner + the secondary hypothesis received empirical confirmation.
hints: Transisi analogi serupa: 'In like manner'.
Klausa: 'the secondary hypothesis received empirical confirmation'.

intermediate.prompt: Logical deduction connector: 'All observed premises have been verified; ___, our theorem is conclusively proven.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Ergo' (oleh karena itu / therefore) berasal dari bahasa Latin dan sering digunakan dalam penalaran deduktif formal.
hints: Kata sambung penalaran deduktif Latin formal.
Gunakan 'ergo'.

intermediate.targetSentence: They achieved their sales targets albeit with considerable difficulty.
intermediate.explanation: They achieved their sales targets + albeit with considerable difficulty.
hints: Klausa hasil: 'They achieved their sales targets'.
Konsesi ringkas: 'albeit with considerable difficulty'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perencanaan strategis jangka panjang.
dialogue: Director
Will the merger complicate our European operations?
Strategist
Undoubtedly. ___, our Asian market presence will expand exponentially.
intermediate.explanation: 'By contrast' menyajikan perbandingan kontras langsung antara situasi Eropa dan Asia.
hints: Membandingkan kontras dua wilayah pasar.
Gunakan 'By contrast'.

intermediate.prompt: Distinguish 'on the contrary' vs 'by contrast': 'The prototype did not overheat during stress tests; ___, core temperatures remained five degrees cooler than forecast.'
intermediate.explanation: 'On the contrary' dipakai khusus SETELAH pernyataan negatif untuk membantah anggapan salah tersebut dan menyatakan kebalikannya ('bahkan sebaliknya...').
hints: Klausa pertama berbentuk negatif ('did not overheat') dan klausa kedua membalik asumsi itu.
Penyangkal pernyataan negatif memakai 'on the contrary'.

intermediate.prompt: Compare with 'by contrast': 'Urban transit lines run electric buses exclusively; ___, suburban routes still rely largely on hybrid vans.'
intermediate.explanation: Di sini tidak ada klaim negatif yang disangkal; kedua klausa sekadar membandingkan perbedaan dua situasi berbeda ('bus kota vs rute pinggiran'), sehingga memakai 'by contrast' (atau 'in contrast').
hints: Kedua kalimat hanya membandingkan dua fakta berbeda tanpa membantah klaim sebelumnya.
Gunakan 'by contrast'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan penyuntingan naskah tentang penggunaan 'thereby' + gerund.
dialogue: Writer
How can I link 'The city widened bike lanes' with its direct result 'lowering commuter collisions' smoothly?
Editor
Connect the participle result cleanly using the adverbial connector ___: '...bike lanes, ___ lowering commuter collisions.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Thereby + V-ing' (= dengan demikian menghasilkan...) adalah cara ringkas dan sangat elegan dalam tulisan akademis untuk mengaitkan aksi klausa utama dengan konsekuensi langsungnya.
hints: Perhatikan bentuk '-ing' ('lowering') setelah koma dan rumpang.
Konektor formal sebelum '-ing' hasil adalah 'thereby'.

intermediate.prompt: In formal legal or historical prose, adverbs like 'herein', 'thereafter', and 'whereby' serve to condense spatial/temporal reference; e.g., 'All parties signed the treaty and ___ observed a ten-year truce.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Thereafter' bermakna 'sejak saat itu / setelah peristiwa tersebut', menggantikan frasa panjang 'after that event'.
hints: Maknanya adalah urutan waktu setelah penandatanganan perjanjian.
'Thereafter' berarti setelah itu.

intermediate.prompt: The new sorting robot processes packages swiftly; ___, it requires quarterly optical sensor cleaning.
intermediate.explanation: 'That said' atau 'Even so' (= meski demikian) mengakui kelebihan klausa pertama lalu memunculkan catatan kontras atau batasan yang perlu diperhatikan.
hints: Ada pengakuan keunggulan + catatan pengecualian kontras.
Gunakan konektor konsesi moderat 'that said / even so'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan konjungsi subordinator dengan konektor adverbial sekaligus berikut.
intermediate.draft: Although the pilot battery charged twice as fast, however its total cycle lifespan shortened noticeably.
options: Although the pilot battery charged twice as fast, its total cycle lifespan shortened noticeably.
Although the pilot battery charged twice as fast, therefore its total cycle lifespan shortened noticeably.
Despite the pilot battery charged twice as fast, however its total cycle lifespan shortened noticeably.
intermediate.explanation: Jangan memakai 'Although' bersama 'however' sekaligus untuk satu hubungan kontras; pilih 'Although...' saja ATAU ganti menjadi titik koma '; however,'.
hints: Satu hubungan kontras cukup memakai satu konektor.
Hapus 'however' dari kalimat yang sudah memakai 'Although'.

intermediate.prompt: High-speed rail trims intercity flight demand; ___, regional airports can reallocate gates to long-haul cargo.
intermediate.explanation: 'Hence' (= oleh karenanya) diikuti klausa hasil atau frasa nomina akibat secara formal dan ringkas.
hints: Klausa kedua adalah konsekuensi logis dari berkurangnya permintaan penerbangan pendek.
Pilih konektor akibat 'hence'.

intermediate.prompt: Choose the precise connector for an appositive restatement: 'Several Nordic utilities rely on dispatchable renewables — ___, hydropower reservoirs and geothermal plants.'
intermediate.explanation: Setelah tanda pisah (em-dash), 'specifically' atau 'namely' menyebutkan daftar pasti dari 'dispatchable renewables' yang dimaksud.
hints: Menjelaskan rincian tepat dari istilah sebelumnya.
Gunakan 'specifically / namely'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai konektor hasil 'thereby' + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: The port automated customs declarations, thereby cutting average container clearance times in half.
intermediate.explanation: Koma + 'thereby' + gerund ('cutting') menyatakan konsekuensi langsung dari tindakan di klausa utama.
hints: Awali dengan 'The port automated customs declarations,'.
Tambahkan ', thereby cutting average container clearance times in half'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuktian konsesi retoris dengan 'admittedly'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Admittedly, initial solar installation outlays remain steep; nonetheless, five-year operating savings justify the shift.
intermediate.explanation: 'Admittedly' mengakui argumen lawan di awal lalu dibalas secara tegas dengan '; nonetheless,'.
hints: Mulai dengan pengakuan 'Admittedly, initial solar installation outlays remain steep;'.
Balas dengan 'nonetheless, five-year operating savings justify the shift'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan tanda baca 'comma splice' pada penggunaan konjungsi transisi.
complex.draft: The treaty negotiations collapsed, nevertheless, the envoys agreed to maintain diplomatic communication.
options: The treaty negotiations collapsed; nevertheless, the envoys agreed to maintain diplomatic communication.
The treaty negotiations collapsed nevertheless, the envoys agreed to maintain communication.
The treaty negotiations collapsed, however nevertheless the envoys agreed to maintain communication.
complex.explanation: 'Nevertheless' adalah conjunctive adverb (adverbia penghubung), BUKAN coordinating conjunction seperti 'and/but'. Menghubungkan dua klausa independen hanya dengan koma menghasilkan 'comma splice' yang keliru. Wajib diawali titik koma (;) atau titik (.).
hints: Gunakan titik koma sebelum conjunctive adverb.
Pilih opsi dengan titik koma sebelum nevertheless.

complex.prompt: Semantic precision: Differentiate 'On the other hand' vs 'On the contrary'. Which rule governs accurate usage?
options: 'On the other hand' balances two valid opposing facets of an issue; 'On the contrary' refutes a preceding negative assertion to state the opposite truth.
'On the contrary' is informal; 'On the other hand' is purely legal.
They are 100% interchangeable in all contexts.
complex.explanation: 'On the other hand' menyeimbangkan dua sisi argumen yang sama-sama valid. Sebaliknya, 'On the contrary' digunakan setelah pernyataan negatif untuk membantah anggapan keliru dan menegaskan kebenaran sebaliknya.
hints: Perbedaan penyeimbang dua sisi vs penyangkalan klaim keliru.
Pilih opsi balances two valid opposing facets vs refutes assertion.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence utilizing archaic legalistic connectors with consummate stylistic accuracy:
options: The parties agreed to the settlement terms; wherein, all mutual claims were irrevocably discharged.
The parties agreed to settlement wherein they made all claims disappear.
Wherein the parties agreed they discharged all things.
complex.explanation: 'Wherein' (di mana / di dalam instrumen tersebut) berfungsi sebagai konektor yuridis elegan yang merangkum substansi perjanjian.
hints: Konektor yuridis baku dalam instrumen penyelesaian sengketa.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat akademik penanda kesimpulan tak terelakkan.
complex.targetSentence: It follows as a necessary corollary that the policy must be repealed.
complex.explanation: It follows as a necessary corollary that + the policy must be repealed.
hints: Mulai dengan deduksi logika formal: 'It follows as a necessary corollary that'.
Kesimpulan: 'the policy must be repealed'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi redundant connectors pada argumen akademik.
complex.draft: Whereas the initial hypothesis appeared robust, however subsequent trials failed to replicate the results.
options: Whereas the initial hypothesis appeared robust, subsequent trials failed to replicate the results.
Whereas the initial hypothesis appeared robust, but subsequent trials failed.
Whereas the initial hypothesis appeared robust, nevertheless subsequent trials failed.
complex.explanation: Jangan menggabungkan subordinating conjunction 'Whereas' dengan conjunctive adverb 'however' dalam kalimat yang sama. Hapus 'however'.
hints: Hapus konektor redundant 'however'.
Pilih kalimat tanpa 'however'.

complex.prompt: Discourse flow in academic monographs: Which connector best announces the culmination of a multi-chapter proof?
options: In light of the preceding analysis, it can be maintained that...
So basically as I said earlier...
complex.explanation: 'In light of the preceding analysis...' merangkum seluruh argumen terdahulu dengan register keilmuan yang berwibawa.
hints: Formula penutup sintesis monograf akademik.
Pilih 'In light of the preceding analysis...'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perumusan klausul putusan hukum.
dialogue: Chief Justice
How does the statute reconcile municipal bylaws with federal statutes?
Clerk
Federal statutes supersede municipal regulations; ___, any inconsistent local ordinance is null and void.
complex.explanation: 'Ipso facto' (oleh fakta itu sendiri / by that very fact) adalah konektor yuridis Latin yang menandakan konsekuensi otomatis menurut hukum.
hints: Istilah hukum Latin untuk konsekuensi otomatis.
Gunakan 'ipso facto'.

complex.prompt: Examine subtle semantic precision: 'Regional grain output surged 20%. ___ expected, export surpluses stabilized domestic bread prices.'
complex.explanation: 'As expected,' berfungsi sebagai comment clause komparatif-korelasi ringkas (setara 'As it was expected,'); hindari memakai 'Therefore' atau 'Such as' sebelum participle tunggal tanpa subjek.
hints: Perhatikan past participle 'expected' berdiri setelah rumpang.
Klausa komentar ringkas memakai 'As expected'.

complex.prompt: In legal statutes, '___ the Seller fails to deliver conforming goods within fourteen days, the Buyer may terminate the order' uses a distinctly legalistic conditional connector:
complex.explanation: Dalam penyusunan pasal kontrak dan undang-undang, 'Where + clause' atau 'In the event that + clause' lazim digunakan sebagai konektor kondisi/skenario hukum ('Dalam hal Penjual gagal...').
hints: Konteksnya penyusunan pasal perjanjian dagang resmi.
Klausa skenario hukum diawali 'In the event that / Where'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan pengunaan 'therefore' hanya dengan koma dan kekeliruan makna 'whereas' pada kalimat berikut.
complex.draft: The urban metro runs cleanly on hydroelectric power, whereas rural diesel buses remain expensive; on the contrary, suburban rail bridges both networks smoothly.
options: The urban metro runs cleanly on hydroelectric power, whereas rural diesel buses remain expensive; meanwhile, suburban rail bridges both networks smoothly.
The urban metro runs cleanly on hydroelectric power; therefore rural diesel buses remain expensive; on the contrary, rail bridges both.
Whereas the urban metro runs cleanly, rural diesel buses remain expensive, on the contrary rail bridges both.
complex.explanation: 'On the contrary' SALAH dipakai di sini karena tidak membantah pernyataan negatif sebelumnya; untuk menambahkan elemen penghubung yang berlangsung bersamaan ('sementara itu'), gunakan 'meanwhile' atau 'similarly'!
hints: Apakah klausa ketiga membantah pernyataan negatif? Tidak.
Gunakan 'meanwhile' setelah titik koma untuk peran penghubung paralel.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang penulisan 'insofar as' vs 'inasmuch as'.
dialogue: Examiner
You wrote 'The model succeeds inasmuch as it accounts for seasonal humidity.' What exact logical relation does 'inasmuch as' signal?
Candidate
'Inasmuch as' signals ___ ('since / to the extent that'), rather than contrast.
complex.explanation: 'Inasmuch as' (bermakna 'mengingat fakta bahwa / sejauh bahwa') menjelaskan dasar alasan atau batasan berlakunya suatu klaim formal.
hints: 'Inasmuch as' mirip 'since / to the extent that'.
Fungsinya menjelaskan sebab/cakupan kualifikasi.

complex.prompt: Note how 'all the same' or 'be that as it may' operates at paragraph transitions: 'Budget approvals faced minor parliamentary delays. ___, construction equipment arrived at the harbor on time.'
complex.explanation: 'Be that as it may,' adalah penanda konsesi retoris berwibawa yang menerima fakta sebelumnya ('bagaimanapun juga / terlepas dari hal itu') lalu membalik fokus ke fakta positif baru.
hints: Kalimat pertama menyebut kendala, kalimat kedua menyebut hasil yang tetap tepat waktu.
Konektor transisi konsesif formal adalah 'Be that as it may'.

complex.prompt: In legal/contractual style, 'heretofore' refers to 'until now', while '___' means 'after this point / from now on in this document'.
complex.explanation: Pasangan kata keterangan hukum klasik: 'heretofore' (sebelum/hingga saat ini) vs 'hereafter / henceforth' (mulai saat ini dan seterusnya).
hints: Lawan kata dari 'until now' dalam bahasa perjanjian formal.
Pilih 'hereafter / henceforth'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan tanda baca setelah 'viz.' / 'i.e.' dan kesalahan makna 'namely' berikut.
complex.draft: Three coastal hubs recorded higher container throughput, i.e., Semarang, Makassar, among others.
options: Three coastal hubs recorded higher container throughput — namely, Semarang, Makassar, and Bitung.
Three coastal hubs recorded higher container throughput, i.e., Semarang, Makassar, and so forth.
Three coastal hubs recorded higher container throughput, namely, among others, Semarang.
complex.explanation: 'i.e.' (= yaitu secara lengkap) dan 'namely' menuntut daftar TUNTAS semua item yang disebut ('Three coastal hubs' → harus menyebutkan KETIGANYA, bukan cuma 2 + 'among others'!). Jika hanya sebagian contoh, harusnya memakai 'e.g.' / 'such as'.
hints: Jika menyebut 'Three coastal hubs', maka daftar setelah 'namely/i.e.' wajib tuntas 3 kota tanpa 'among others'.
Aturan logika aposisi vs eksemplifikasi.

complex.prompt: The empirical findings align with earlier surveys; ___, they extend the analysis into rural service wages.
complex.explanation: Kalimat kedua tidak hanya sejajar, tetapi memperluas temuan sebelumnya ke dimensi baru; gunakan konektor aditif progresif 'moreover,' atau 'furthermore,'.
hints: Hubungannya memperluas argumen searah.
Pilih konektor tambahan progresif 'moreover, / in addition,'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai 'Granted, ...; nevertheless, ...' untuk konsesi seimbang.
complex.targetSentence: Granted, manual data cleaning takes longer upfront; nevertheless, it eliminates costly model drift.
complex.explanation: Mengakui keberatan dengan 'Granted,' di awal lalu menutupnya dengan '; nevertheless,' membentuk argumen persuasif seimbang.
hints: Awali dengan 'Granted, manual data cleaning takes longer upfront;'.
Sambungkan dengan 'nevertheless, it eliminates costly model drift'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat hukum presisi memakai 'notwithstanding anything to the contrary'.
complex.targetSentence: Notwithstanding prior verbal assurances, only signed written addenda modify delivery deadlines.
complex.explanation: 'Notwithstanding + noun phrase' menempatkan pengecualian tegas di awal kalimat hukum.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Notwithstanding prior verbal assurances,'.
Akhiri dengan klausa utama 'only signed written addenda...'.
